description: z-scores and Gaussian tail probabilities of the observed eigenvalues against the column-scrambled null. No distribution is fitted; the null mean and sd are the empirical moments of the B permutation draws.

method.moments: empirical mean and sd (ddof=1) of the B scrambled lambda_k
method.p: p_k = SF_normal(z_k), i.e. P(X > lambda_obs_k) for X ~ Normal(mean_k, sd_k)
method.assumption_caveat: the null largest eigenvalue is asymptotically Tracy-Widom, right tail exp(-(2/3)s^{3/2}), heavier than the Gaussian exp(-s^2/2); p_gaussian is therefore anti-conservative, increasingly so at large z
method.diagnostics: skewness, excess_kurtosis and normaltest p on the null draws quantify the departure from Gaussian
method.monte_carlo: sd from B draws carries relative error 1/sqrt(2(B-1)) = 0.0711, which propagates directly into z
